intro: These terms govern your use of PropertyOS, an app that helps property owners in Maharashtra track properties, tenants, agreements, rent and compliance in one place. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: 1. What PropertyOS is
sections.body: PropertyOS is a personal record-keeping and organization tool for property owners. It helps you track property, tenant, agreement, rent and utility-bill information, and surfaces Maharashtra rental-compliance reference information. It does not generate legally binding documents on its own, act as your registered agent, or file anything with any government authority on your behalf.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
sections.body: You need an account, secured by an email address and password, to use PropertyOS. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity under your account. Tell us as soon as possible if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.

sections.heading: 3. Your responsibilities
sections.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the property, owner, tenant and agreement information you enter, and for keeping it up to date. You agree to use PropertyOS only for lawful purposes connected to managing your own properties, and not to use it to store or process data belonging to, or about, anyone without an appropriate basis for doing so (for example, a tenant's consent to hold their details as part of a tenancy).

sections.heading: 4. Not legal, financial or tax advice
sections.body: Compliance reference information shown in the app (for example, the Maharashtra Compliance screen) is guidance only, intended to help you understand common requirements. It is not a substitute for advice from a qualified lawyer, chartered accountant or other professional, and PropertyOS is not responsible for decisions made in reliance on it. Always verify current requirements independently before relying on them, especially for anything with legal or financial consequences.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the app — including attempting to access another user's data, interfering with the service's normal operation, or using it to store unlawful content. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate this.

sections.heading: 6. Service availability
sections.body: We aim to keep PropertyOS available and your data intact, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted access. Features may change, be added, or be removed as the app develops. We recommend keeping your own backups of anything critical (such as agreement documents) outside the app as well.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.body: PropertyOS is provided on an "as is" basis. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential loss arising from your use of the app, including loss of data, income or business opportunity. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

sections.heading: 8. Termination
sections.body: You may stop using PropertyOS and request deletion of your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if these terms are violated, or discontinue the service with reasonable notice where practical.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms as the app evolves. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated effective date; continuing to use PropertyOS after a change means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: 10. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of Maharashtra, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
